title: AI Lab | AI at Princeton
description: # AI at Princeton. # AI Lab. * A crowd watches the AI Lab Distinguished Lecture Series. * Participants at the AI Lab Student/Researcher UnConference. * Student presentation at the AI Lab. * Research software engineer giving a presentation at the AI Lab Unconference. Yihe Dong, AI Lab research software engineer, presents at the Student/Researcher UnConference. Princeton has developed a series of major research initiatives to move at the speed of AI discovery. Natural and Artificial Minds takes advantage of advances in AI to study natural and artificial minds in parallel, creating the opportunity to make discoveries about ourselves and to find new ways to understand and improve AI systems. Princeton Language and Intelligence (PLI) seeks to develop fundamental understanding of large AI models; enable their application to research and education across academic disciplines; and study societal and ethical implications of AI as well as develop methods to avert any harms. Watch Session Recording of Learning Through the Eyes and Ears of a Child.
